stories.title: Major changes coming to CA Dept. of Education starting in 2027
stories.summary: Once Governor, Xavier Becerra will appoint California's first-ever education commissioner, who will take over running the state Department of Education.

stories.title: 3 juveniles in custody after 40-mile stolen car pursuit from Stockton to Sacramento County
stories.summary: Three juveniles are in custody and a stolen firearm was recovered after a 40-mile pursuit that began in Stockton and ended in Sacramento County.

stories.title: Sacramento Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Flooding concerns for the Delta and near the deep water channel in West Sacramento due to coastal King Tides. Chance of overnight showers Tuesday then dry.

stories.title: King Tides bring flood warnings to Delta counties
stories.summary: San Joaquin County leaders say newer forecasts are giving them optimism when it comes to potential local impacts.

stories.title: Northern California prepares for King Tides as Thanksgiving travel approaches
stories.summary: As Northern California braces for another storm coinciding with King Tides, Cal OES and local officials prepare for potential flooding and hazardous conditions.

stories.title: How a Sacramento jewelry artist’s Yurok designs caught Vogue’s eye
stories.summary: Vogue spotlighted Jessica Mendez’s earrings after Minnesota Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan wore them during her election-night victory speech.

stories.title: Why an Indigenous-led group wants to turn a Point Reyes cabin into a history center
stories.summary: Decades after her family was evicted, Theresa Harlan is asking the National Park Service for a role in caring for the site.

stories.title: 19-year-old identified in fatal Roseville DUI crash involving two Teslas
stories.summary: A teenager was identified as the person killed in a crash involving two Teslas in Roseville Saturday night that left three others critically injured.

stories.title: Samantha Cypret draws on her Native heritage to lead change at California State University
stories.summary: As CSU’s assistant vice chancellor for tribal relations, the Mountain Maidu works to return ancestral remains and strengthen relationships with tribal nations

stories.title: High tides prompt Flood Warning for parts of Solano County
stories.summary: A Flood Warning is in effect for low-lying areas along the San Pablo Bay, Carquinez Strait and Suisun Bay shorelines until 4 p.m. Thursday due to high tides.

stories.title: Sacramento Republic FC to hold USL championship parade in Sacramento Monday
stories.summary: Sacramento Republic FC will celebrate with a downtown parade Monday, Nov. 23, beginning at noon, with road closures starting 30 minutes earlier.

stories.title: California cybersecurity startup identifies major software bug, prompting urgent calls for companies to install an update
stories.summary: A California company used AI to uncover a software bug in Java, one of the world’s most widely used programming language.
